Satellite NANOSATC-BR2
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 2U
Status Reentry 2025-01-15. Was semi-operational until 2021-05-02 (Beacons decoded, but uplink was challenging and then communcation bus locked up, according to official information request by Brazilian Space)
Launched 2021-03-22
NORAD ID 47950
Deployer QuadPack (XL) [ISISpace]
Launcher Sojuz
Organization National Institute for Space Research
Institution Institute
Entity type Government (Civil / Military)
Nation Brazil
Partners Brazilian National Institute of Space Research (INPE), Federal University of Santa Maria (UFSM)
Oneliner

Langmuir probe, attitude determination system.

Failure cause Temperatures well below the nominal range caused significant fluctuations in uplink and downlink frequencies. On May 2, telemetry frame started to be repeated due to lock of the communication bus likely due to the high solar activity.
